text: This is probably nothing and I feel a bit daft messaging, but I'd rather ask. I childmind a girl who's 10 and earlier this evening she was messing about and knocked her head on the edge of the kitchen table, the forehead bit just above her eyebrow. She cried straight away, a proper loud cry, so she definitely didn't go quiet or anything, and I gave her a cuddle and an ice pack wrapped in a tea towel. That was about an hour and a half ago. Since then honestly she's been completely her normal self, eating her tea, arguing with me about screen time, chatting about school, doing her usual nonsense. I've never really had a head bump with one of mine before so I wasn't sure if there's a time I should be keeping an eye on her for, or if I need to tell her mum anything particular when she picks her up. Like I said, she seems absolutely fine, I just don't want to get it wrong.
